_comment: Test classes that check_new_tests_ran.py may see added/modified without them executing in CI. Key: FQCN, python module or repo path (fnmatch patterns allowed); value: why it does not run in CI. Keep this list short: a class that should run belongs in a suite, not here.
datahub.client.v2.integration.*: Java SDK v2 integration tests need a live DataHub (DATAHUB_SERVER) and skip themselves without one; run manually per datahub-client/CLAUDE.md.
datahub.client.patch.PatchTest: Every method is @Ignore'd: examples that target a GMS on localhost.
com.linkedin.metadata.search.embedding.C: Calls the Cohere API; skips without an API key, which CI does not have.
com.linkedin.metadata.search.embedding.O: Calls the OpenAI API; skips without an API key, which CI does not have.
Manual benchmark; skips unless explicitly enabled.
com.linkedin.metadata.search.SemanticSea: Class-level @Test(enabled = false): needs a live OpenSearch with semantic indices.
com.linkedin.metadata.search.semantic.Se: Class-level @Test(enabled = false): needs a live OpenSearch with semantic indices.
io.datahubproject.test.fixtures.search.S: Manual fixture-capture tool; its @Test methods are @Ignore'd on purpose.
com.linkedin.datahub.upgrade.system.elas: Opt-in :datahub-upgrade:searchV3MigrationTest task only (SEARCH_V3_MIGRATION_TEST=true); not wired into CI on purpose, see datahub-upgrade/build.gradle.
Opt-in :datahub-upgrade:searchV3MigrationTest task only (SEARCH_V3_MIGRATION_TEST=true); not wired into CI on purpose, see datahub-upgrade/build.gradle.
tests.integration.hana.test_hana: SAP HANA Express image and hdbcli driver are x86_64-only; CI runners are ARM, so the test skips itself.
tests.integration.hive-metastore.test_hi: HMS 3.x docker environment is skipped in CI by design; run with RUN_HMS3_TESTS=1 or HMS3_EXTERNAL=1.
tests.integration.informix.test_informix: Skipped when is_ci(): the Informix developer image cannot start on CI runners (PAM/sudo). Run locally.
tests.integration.notion.test_notion_int: Needs a live Notion workspace (NOTION_* env vars) that CI does not have.
tests.integration.pgqueue.test_pgqueue_o: Module-level skip: needs Postgres with pg_partman + SqlSetup DDL, not wired in CI.
tests.integration.vertica.test_vertica: Module-level skip until vertica/vertica-containers#64 is fixed.
tests.unit.utilities.test_cli_logging: Module-level skip: reconfiguring logging breaks pytest's own capture.
